note: Same object: the concrete dot product in R^n=V_n (sum of products of corresponding components = v^T w). Apostol frames it as a concept (the model the inner product generalizes); Strang as notation v·w=v^T w. Content identical, types differ (concept vs notation).

Apostol's axiomatic real inner product (unique real number satisfying symmetry/linearity/homogeneity/positivity, defined without a formula, valid on function spaces) is the general; Strang's dot product v^T w in R^n is one concrete instance.
The four inner-product axioms (abstract) vs the R^n dot product, which satisfies them as one instance.

Notation-level: Apostol's general inner-product notation (x,y) (explicitly replacing x·y) vs Strang's concrete dot-product notation v·w=v^T w. Borderline; the abstract notation subsumes the concrete one as an instance.

Orthogonality as product=0. Apostol: any inner product on any Euclidean space, incl. infinite-dim function spaces; Strang: v^T w=0 in R^n. Same definitional pattern but Strang's uses the dot-product instance, so special-case rather than strict-same (generality gap over function spaces).

Shared fact 'self-orthogonal implies zero': Apostol folds 'the zero element is the only element orthogonal to itself' into the orthogonality concept; Strang states 'a vector orthogonal to itself is the zero vector' (R^n instance, from v^T v=||v||^2=0). Strang's surrounding subspace-intersection framing has no abstract counterpart in this block.

Abstract Euclidean-space definitions and inner-product variants (integral function-space, weighted, complex/unitary, real Euclidean space, real-or-complex Euclidean space) — no counterpart in Strang's R^n-only block. The complex/integral/weighted variants do NOT collapse onto Strang's single real dot product.

Metric apparatus: norm definition ||x||=(x,x)^(1/2), norm notation, norm properties theorem, triangle inequality, Cauchy-Schwarz, angle between elements. Strang uses ||v|| once (s410) but defines none of these in this block.
Orthogonal sets, independence of orthogonal sets, orthonormal sets, Parseval's formula, and orthogonal-basis coordinate formulas — no counterpart in this Strang block.

Subspace-level notions: orthogonal subspaces, orthogonal complement (V^perp), row/column-space vs nullspace perpendicularity, unique split x=x_r+x_n, and the Fundamental Theorem's four-subspaces result. These belong to Apostol's projection/subspace material, not this inner-product block.
Pythagorean/right-triangle identity ||v||^2+||w||^2=||v+w||^2 for orthogonal vectors. Apostol's block has the triangle inequality (a419) but no Pythagorean theorem, so no match here.
